Facility Name: Radiation Oncology Facility at UT Southwestern Medical Center
Location Address: 400 W Magnolia Avenue, Fort Worth, TX 76104
Type of Funds: This project is privately funded, on private land for private use.
Scope of Work: This is a two-story radiology center. It consists of approximately 65,000 SF and two levels. Level 1 includes 5 linear accelerators, 1 MRI, 1 MR SIM, and 1 HDR. Level 2 includes 1 PET CT, 1 CT Simulator, and Administration.
